correctness.rationale: The equilibrium law uniquely eliminates storage as a positive-part recursion. Induction from leaves establishes convex piecewise-affine responses and a unique positive activation for every store. For distinct times, a derivative jump propagates to the root exactly across already-active ancestors, multiplied by the strictly positive spill fractions. Recursively chosen positive capacities realize arbitrary activation orders, hence all counts of visible outlet thresholds. Choosing every nonroot capacity below its local-input threshold at a fixed root activation creates an explicit n-1 dimensional family with identical complete steady outlet response. The exact-rational checker exercises the formulas and nonidentifiability witnesses, but the proof does not rely on finite tests.

originality.rationale: The inspected hydrological studies establish physical filling-spilling-connectivity and numerical dynamical threshold models, but do not establish the exact arbitrary-tree steady derivative-jump criterion, attainable count classification, or full-curve positive-dimensional capacity nonidentifiability. General piecewise-linear network theory covers mathematical shape but not this constrained hydrologic structure or identification statement. Priority remains provisional; a plausible 2013 dynamic puddle-network full text was inaccessible, and other general graph identifiability theorems may exist.
residual_risks: A 2013 dynamic puddle-network paper (DOI:10.1002/wrcr.20286) has not been compared at complete-text level, and an inaccessible stronger theorem could subsume part of the finding.
General exact inverse-equivalence results for positively weighted one-dimensional ReLU networks or monotone hydraulic networks might imply portions of the theorem under different terminology.
A hydrology-wide conceptual invisibility claim is established in prior literature; only the stated exact restricted-class quantitative theorem is assessed as new.

value.rationale: An all-tree exact visibility condition shows when genuine internal activation can be inferred from the complete steady outlet forcing-response curve and constructs physically positive continuum counterexamples where even the full curve cannot identify internal capacities. The sharp 1..n kink realizability result shows the observational limitation holds for every network shape rather than one arbitrarily chosen graph. It gives interpretable structural guidance for drainage-network monitoring, with limits to a simplified steady linear benchmark; no general empirical implication is asserted.
